RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, September 5, 2011/Bhadra 14, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Corporate Affairs; Earth Sciences; Information and Broadcasting;
Law and Justice; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Mines;
Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Parliamentary
Affairs; Power; Science and Technology; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
National Mineral Policy
*441. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD SAHU:
Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a National Mineral Policy
is being formulated;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether unorganised mines are being
brought under the proposed Policy; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
criteria for selection of such unorganised
mines?
CPSUs under the Ministry
*442. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the names and locations of the Central
Public Sector Undertakings working under
the Ministry;
(b) the number of contract/casual
labourers appointed therein during the last
three years;
(c) the areas/jobs in which these
labourers were appointed;
(d) the number of such labourers who
were regularized during the last three years;
(e) the mechanism adopted to ensure
minimum wages to these workers;
(f) the mechanism adopted to ensure that
the provisions of various labour laws are
not violated by contractors and others; and
(g) the actions taken in case of
complaints and violations by contractors
and others?
Protection of old dams
*443. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of W A TER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of dams in India that are
more than 100 years old;
(b) the steps taken by Government for
protection of these old dams;
(c) the funds allocated and spent for
this purpose during the last three years,
State-wise;

128
(d) whether Andhra Pradesh
Government has sent any proposal in this
regard; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken thereon?
River linking scheme
*444. DR. RAM PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of river linking scheme in
the country;
(b) the rivers which would be under this
network in Haryana;
(c) how much is the budget and how
much has already been spent till December,
2010, project-wise; and
(d) whether the river linking scheme is
viable these days?
Scrapping of Urdu television serials
*445. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that duly
approved/selected television serials for
Urdu channel of Doordarshan have been
scrapped by the acting Chief Executive
Officer of Prasar Bharati;
(b) if so, the reasons and justification
therefor; and
(c) whether any responsibility has been
fixed on erring officers for scrapping of these
serials and, if not, the reasons therefor?
Contribution of MSMEs to GDP
*446. SHRI A VINASH PANDE: Will
the Minister of MICRO, SMALL AND
MEDIUM ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has estimated
the output/contribution of Micro, Small
and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) to
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) during the
last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is planning to
introduce priority based procurement from
MSMEs for boosting their growth and
contribution to GDP;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what other measures have been taken
by Government for boosting growth of
MSMEs?
Rural electrification targets
*447. DR. BHALCHANDRA
MUNGEKAR: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the targets set for electrification of
villages and poor households in the country
during 2009-10 and 2010-11 and how much
of it has been achieved till date;
(b) the major reasons for gaps, if any, in
targets and achievements; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
speed up the process of implementation
so that these  targets can be achieved within
the stipulated time-frame?
Misleading advertisements
*448. PROF. ANIL KUMAR
SAHANI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether some companies like
Himani, Hindustan Unilever, Himalaya,
Complan, etc. are marketing fairness
creams, dandruff removal shampoos, etc.
misguiding their customers by broadcasting

129
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
misleading advertisements on television,
etc.; and
(b) whether there is any proposal to
verify the claims of these companies to
check the effectiveness of their products
and to book unscrupulous companies for
misleading advertisements and misguiding
the consumers?
Per capita power consumption
*449. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the average per capita
power consumption in the country is much
below as compared to some developed and
emerging nations; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Procurement of rice
*450. SHRI N. BALAGANGA: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether procurement of rice has
declined during the last two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the production and procurement of rice
during the last two years and the current
year, State-wise;
(c) the details of the contribution of each
State to the Central Pool; and
(d) the steps taken to improve the
procurement?
State Minorities Commissions in
North Eastern States
*451. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of
MINORITY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Minorities
Commissions have been set up in the North
Eastern States and whether there are
statutory bodies in all the States;
(b) if not, whether the Assam State
Minorities Commission would be made a
statutory body; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Geothermal energy potential in
Ladakh
*452. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of NEW
AND RENEWABLE ENERGYbe pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a lot
of geothermal energy potential in the Ladakh
region of Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any effort has been made to
tap the geothermal energy in that region;
(d) if so, the results thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Rain water harvesting and ground
water conservation training camps
†*453. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of W ATER RESOURCES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether rain water harvesting/
groundwater conservation training camps
are being organised in the country or such
camps and awareness campaigns are going
to be organised;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether there is any mechanism/
technique to find out the availability of
ground water; and

130
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Inclusion of water in Concurrent  List
*454. SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ashok
Chawla Committee, appointed by the Prime
Minister, to look into water scenario of the
country, has suggested to bring water from
the State List to the Concurrent List;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this recommendation, if
accepted by Government, would lead to
more centralization and creation of
problems in water management at local level
in the States; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Fair and remunerative price for
sugarcane
*455. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government takes into
consideration the different climatic/
geographical/socio-economic conditions
prevailing in the States while calculating/
fixing Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP)
for sugarcane;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the parameters on the basis of which
the calculation of FRP for the sugarcane
crushing season 2010-11 was fixed, along
with the names of the institutions involved
in finalizing the parameters and fixing the
FRP; and
(d) the details of the input cost for
cultivation of sugarcane along with the data
used for calculation of FRP during
2010-11?
Declaration of river projects as
national assets
*456. SHRI SHADI LAL BATRA: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has declared
some of the river projects as national assets
for conservation of water;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the extent to which water supply
for drinking and irrigation purposes would
be improved with these projects?
Performance of coal sector
*457. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has identified
the companies which are deliberately
under-performing in the coal sector;
(b) the details of each of the 208
companies to which coal blocks were
allocated and the progress of work of each
of the companies; and
(c) the details of the companies, in
private and public sector out of the above
208 companies which have been
deliberately under-performing during the
last one decade?
Revision of pension of retired
employees of CIL
*458. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the number of retired employees of
Coal India Limited (CIL) covered under the
Coal Mines Pension Scheme, 1998;

131
(b) whether the Actuary, appointed by
Government for valuation of pension of
employees of CIL, has submitted its report;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor;
(e) the reasons for non-revision of
pension of workers/officials of CIL since
1998; and
(f) by when the pension of these
employees of CIL would be revised, in view
of exorbitant price rise and resultant plights
and sufferings of these pensioners?
Achievements under  CADWM
programme
*459. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the physical and
financial targets vis-a-vis  their
achievements under the Command Area
Development and Water Management
(CADWM) programme during the last three
years, State-wise;
(b) whether the targets fixed have not
been achieved; and
(c) if so, the details of action taken to
achieve the targets in a time bound manner,
particularly for the current fiscal year?
Mines in Orissa
*460. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) how many mines were operational
in Orissa during the last three years;
(b) the names of the persons operating
these mines along with the names of those
mines;
(c) whether it is a fact that the State
Government has already probed the nexus
between the operating contractors and
Government officials; and
(d) if so, the findings thereof?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 30th August, 2011 Secretary-General.
Bhadra 8, 1933 (Saka)

132
